verdict.rationale: Fly.io's own Sprites marketing says agents can be given per-Sprite access to org-connected services. That access can be scoped by Sprite name, label, or down to a single endpoint, rotated centrally, and revoked for one Sprite. This is a direct least-privilege credential capability for agents, but it is evidenced only by homepage copy, with no technical docs. Missing for 10: documentation of how scoped credentials or tokens are issued and configured, evidence of scoped Fly.io platform API tokens (e.g. for the Machines API or flyctl), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: Grant access on purpose: by Sprite name, by label, or down to a single endpoint, so a Slack bot can post messages and never touch admin.
Rotate once and every Sprite has the new credential. Cut off a single Sprite and the rest never notice.
Connect a service once for your whole org, and every Sprite can reach it. Nobody pastes a token.
